checks.name: actual known/unknown computations publish through one typed model with persistent group identity
older captured generation leaves pending repair; subsequent publication rejects stale results
direct unknown dismissal/deletion updates stored group and retains identity after tombstone
expiry deadline is inclusive; atomic wake survives retry/rollback and publishes tombstone with new generation
ordinary authenticated/service roles cannot read private maintained rows
